notes: «جميعا» joins the two co-transmitters at the first level: their routes meet at Yaqub
«أنه سمع عمر بن عبد العزيز، يسأل السائب» puts Umar in the scene only; Sa'ib becomes the link when he speaks («فقال السائب سمعت»), written with the fuller form «السائب بن يزيد»
«أبي» is Yaqub's father, a relation link with no name
